blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Canada steps up its trade push, using newly concluded free trade agreements with the Philippines and Asean to break its reliance on the US market and open new export frontiers. Asean’s 700 million consumers and $6-trillion economy offer Canadian exporters a vast market for expansion, Canadian Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu told reporters Sunday in Manila, where the 49th Asean Summit will be held. On Saturday, Canada finalized negotiations for a free trade agreement (FTA) with the Philippines and “substantially concluded” talks for a separate deal with Asean.
